high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "mallikastomar." The post features a person taking a mirror selfie using a smartphone with a triple-lens camera. The individual has long, straight red hair and is wearing a sleeveless dark-colored top. They are holding the phone in their right hand, capturing the reflection in a large, ornate mirror with a turquoise-green frame that has intricate, swirling patterns. The background appears to be a textured, light-colored wall, possibly made of plaster or concrete, which adds a rustic feel to the setting.
